steps.name: resources-help
steps.stdout:
Set the workspace VM's RAM (--memory 4G) and/or vCPUs (--cpus N)

Usage:
  daft workspace resources [flags]

Flags:
      --config-dir string     override the daft client config dir (default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/daft/client)
      --cpus uint32           guest vCPU count (0 clears, reverts to default)
      --disk string           retained workspace disk allowance, e.g. 20G (empty selects the 20 GiB default)
  -h, --help                  help for resources
      --memory string         guest RAM, e.g. 4G / 512M (empty clears, reverts to default)
      --name string           workspace name (default: basename of the current directory)
      --orchestrator string   orchestrator URL (https://host:port)
      --timeout duration      overall RPC timeout (default 35s)
      --uuid string           address the workspace by canonical UUID instead of name

Global Flags:
  -v, --verbose   enable verbose output (env: DAFT_VERBOSE)
steps.failure: stdout missing "Set the workspace VM's RAM, retained disk allowance, and/or vCPUs"
